messages.subject: Redirect on application error
parts:
Hi

I am currently writing a shiny server hosted app to perform analyses for other members of the company for whom I work. This app basically takes in take, performs the selected analysis and returns some results.

My question revolves around the (initially likely!) situation that the app errors. Currently when this happens what I assume is a standard pop-up appears saying "The application unexpectedly exited \ Diagnostic information...". Is it possible to make the shiny server look for a crashed app and redirect to a webpage instead of producing this pop-up? My idea here is that the webpage can include my contact details so the end user has an immediate line of help.

Thanks
